comment: Alice's first pre-key message delivered to Bob with EIGHT_TORSION[1] added to its base key. The tweaked key was precomputed once with curve25519-dalek 5.0.0 from this run's honest base key abbb904f2c8f86f71332b8059313b1a1cbad7b332d85927b485e5b0e1049c34d (MontgomeryPoint::to_edwards(0) + EIGHT_TORSION[1], to_montgomery). Same setup and RNG seeds as cheval26-small-subgroup-high-bit.
